name: Spoken SQuAD
ability_definition: The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

task_realism.reasoning: Answering factual questions about a spoken passage does resemble one real listening task: absorbing information from a lecture, briefing or recorded presentation and recalling specifics. But the content is encyclopedic Wikipedia prose read aloud. Workplace oral comprehension mostly involves conversations, instructions, meetings, phone calls and dialogue with turn-taking, hesitations and implicit meaning. Monologue reading of written text is a narrow and atypical case.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: The audio is TTS-generated from a single synthetic voice, with no background noise, accents, overlapping speakers, disfluencies or spontaneous prosody. Many systems, including the paired result, work largely from the provided ASR transcripts. The task therefore partly reduces to reading noisy text rather than listening. There is no real-time constraint, no chance to ask for clarification, and no interactive context.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It captures a genuine slice of the ability: extracting factual information from speech despite recognition errors. It does not test following multi-step spoken instructions, inferring speaker intent or tone, understanding pragmatics or emotion, tracking multi-party discourse, or synthesizing ideas across a long conversation. Extractive span questions also limit the depth of 'understanding ideas' that is probed.

format_match.reasoning: The input is a spoken document, which is partly realistic. The questions are written text, though, and the outputs are extractive spans scored by EM/F1 against the transcript. Real workplace outputs of listening are actions, summaries, notes or free-form responses, not span extraction from a synthetic recording.

transferability_reasoning: Spoken SQuAD is a legitimate listening-comprehension benchmark and tests speech-based understanding more directly than intent or slot tasks. Its transfer to workplace Oral Comprehension is limited by TTS-read Wikipedia monologues, text questions, and extractive span answers. It mainly measures factual extraction from ASR-noisy content, not comprehension of natural, conversational, multi-speaker speech in real settings.

2020.model_or_system: ALBERT-large (fine-tuned on Text-SQuAD, evaluated on ASR transcripts of the Spoken-SQuAD test set)
2020.metric: F1 (%) on the Spoken-SQuAD test set
2020.human_reference: General adult / educated workforce listening to spoken expository passages (Wikipedia-style) and answering factual questions about them

2021.model_or_system: You et al. 2021: BERT-based SQA model with self-supervised auxiliary tasks, contrastive learning and Temporal-Alignment Attention
2021.metric: F1 (%) on the Spoken SQuAD test set
2021.human_reference: General adult workforce: literate adults who listen to spoken informational content such as briefings, lectures and explanations at work and answer factual questions about it.
